title: Reconciling Process Supervision with Outcome-Based Credit in Agentic Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.31077v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides verified feedback for language-model agents, but assigns trajectory-level advantage uniformly to all decisions, yielding coarse credit over long-horizon interactions. On-policy self-distillation offers finer supervision by re-evaluating sampled behavior with privileged information (PI) available only during training. However, fine-grained supervision is not necessarily fine-grained credit: PI-induced likelihood changes describe how additional information alters policy preference, but do not directly determine how an executable action should inherit the verified task outcome. This creates a supervision-credit gap. Privileged signals may be irrelevant to the current interaction state, operate at a token granularity misaligned with executable decisions, and lack the outcome semantics required for reinforcement. translated_title: 在智能体策略优化中调和过程监督与基于结果的信用分配
translated_abstract: 基于结果的强化学习为语言模型智能体提供了经过验证的反馈，但它将轨迹级的优势统一地分配给所有决策，导致在长程交互中产生粗粒度的信用分配。在策略自蒸馏通过利用仅在训练阶段可用的特权信息（PI）重新评估采样行为，从而提供更精细的监督。然而，细粒度的监督并不等于细粒度的信用：PI引起的似然变化描述了额外信息如何改变策略偏好，但并不能直接决定一个可执行的动作应如何继承经验证的任务结果。这就产生了“监督-信用鸿沟”。特权信号可能与当前交互状态无关，以与可执行决策不匹配的token粒度运作，并且缺乏强化学习所必需的结果语义。我们提出了TASPO，它将特权监督转换为以结果为依据的动作信用分配（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: TASPO方法解决了智能体强化学习中的“监督-信用鸿沟”问题，将仅训练时可用的特权信息所提供的细粒度过程监督，转化为与任务结果挂钩的动作级信用分配，从而克服轨迹级统一优势分配的粗粒度缺陷。
en_tdlr: TASPO reconciles fine-grained process supervision with outcome-based credit assignment by converting privileged-information-based supervision into outcome-grounded action-level credit, bridging the supervision-credit gap in agentic policy optimization.
